name: Matsukawa (Japan, village)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Matsukawa village emblem in white: an outlined ring open at the bottom enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Matsukawa, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 October 1977; the emblem dates from 20 December 1966.

features.role: Matsukawa village emblem — an outlined ring open at the bottom enclosing three vertical bars
